name: Bansisons Tea Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Bansisons Tea Industries Ltd produces tea, and leases tea garden[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
BTIL is in the business of tea plantation, production, and marketing. Initially, 
it concentrated its main activities on increasing 
the tea plantation maintenance of tea bushes and tea manufacturing. Currently, it is in the
 business of leasing of garden for plucking
 of green leaves.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.16% over last 3 years.
